description: This file defines the MessageOnlyLogFilter class, which implements the LogNode interface. Its purpose is to filter log messages to only pass the message content, omitting metadata like priority, tags, and exceptions. It is used as part of a logging chain to simplify log output, especially for on-screen displays.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A log filter class implementing LogNode that passes only message strings, stripping away other metadata.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that optionally takes the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Processes a log message; passes only the message content to the next node.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
